subject.title: fix(ollama): remote Ollama streaming stalls at model_call:started on slow hosts

question: Should native Ollama streaming treat models.providers.ollama.timeoutSeconds as an idle/progress timeout while response chunks arrive, matching sibling stream transports, or preserve a total request cap?
rationale: Source review supports the patch shape, but changing a documented provider timeout behavior can affect existing operator expectations and cannot be settled by code inspection alone.

options.title: Require proof and accept idle parity
options.body: Ask for redacted remote or slow Ollama proof, then allow the native stream path to match sibling guarded stream transports by refreshing the timeout while chunks arrive.

options.title: Preserve a total cap
options.body: Require the PR to keep a separate total deadline or update the approach if maintainers want timeoutSeconds to remain a hard request cap for Ollama streams.

options.title: Pause for canonical issue validation
options.body: Hold this PR until the canonical remote-Ollama issue has a maintainer-run live repro or a different proof-backed fix path.

recommendation.title: Require proof and accept idle parity
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted remote or slow Ollama proof, then allow the native stream path to match sibling guarded stream transports by refreshing the timeout while chunks arrive.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent history on the affected Ollama stream implementation.
